## Goal / acceptance criteria
Each `distro/*/README.md` says clearly: community recipe, version 0.3.1, hashes are placeholders until the release hashes are filled, not submitted upstream, and how a maintainer would verify. No edits to the recipe files themselves. `tests/copilot/test_cp_packaging_lint.py` must still pass.

Fake data only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Tests must pass on Windows too: `tmp_path` and `pathlib`, no hard-coded `/tmp` or POSIX-only paths. A real product bug = strict `xfail` with the reason plus a file:line finding in VENDOR_STATUS.md; never edit `src/`. Check existing tests first (`tests/`, `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/`, `tests/grok/`) and don't duplicate a guard.

## Allowed paths
- `distro/aur/README.md`
- `distro/flatpak/README.md`
- `distro/homebrew/README.md`
- `distro/scoop/README.md`
- `distro/winget/README.md`
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Required checks
- `PYTHONPATH=$PWD/src ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/copilot/test_cp_packaging_lint.py tests -k distro`
